subject.title: Context Overflow: large tool outputs exceed context window, compaction can't recover, sessions enter failure loop

question: Does the current recovery contract guarantee that an aggregate overflow from multiple medium tool results is reduced and retried without resetting or permanently blocking the active session?
rationale: The existing prevention layers may already address the report, but their recovery integration and desired terminal behavior need owner confirmation plus a current-main reproduction before changing context/session policy.

options.title: Prove current behavior
options.body: Reproduce the reported aggregate scenario on current main and close only if the active session continues without destructive reset or repeated failure.

options.title: Repair the recovery handoff
options.body: If aggregate overflow bypasses recovery, make the guard select bounded tool-result elision or compaction before a session-blocking outcome.

options.title: Define terminal recovery UX
options.body: If a blocked state remains necessary after bounded retries, specify the preserved-session and user-visible recovery contract separately.

recommendation.title: Prove current behavior
recommendation.body: Reproduce the reported aggregate scenario on current main and close only if the active session continues without destructive reset or repeated failure.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable source-history attribution was available in the supplied review context.
